07041 Qelayah {kay-law-yaw'}

源自 07034; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Kelaiah 1; 1

基拉雅 = "耶和華蒙羞"
1) 以斯拉時代娶外邦女子為妻的一位利未人  (#拉 10:23|)
   1a) 也做 '基利他'

07041 Qelayah {kay-law-yaw'}

from 07034;; n pr m

AV - Kelaiah 1; 1

Kelaiah = "Jehovah has dishonoured"
1) a Levite who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
   1a) also 'Kelita'
